rubrics.justification: Generally recognizes a blastocyst cavity and transfer-quality embryo, but overstates confidence in 2AA features; the image appears somewhat collapsed/irregular with ICM and TE not clearly demonstrable as tightly packed/cohesive A grades from this single frame.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometrium, smoking, BMI, prior cycle, male factor, and semen parameters with prognosis in a clinically meaningful way, though some points are a bit generic.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a logical link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include overconfidence in morphology and some ambiguity around day-4 blastocyst interpretation.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: morphology is not equated with ploidy, smoking cessation is emphasized, single embryo transfer is favored at age 34, and PGT-A is not routinely mandated after one failed cycle. Minor deviations include somewhat imprecise discussion of day-4 blastocyst timing and semen interpretation.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle optimization, and future-cycle review, including SET preference, luteal support adherence, and consideration of ICSI/DFI testing if failures recur; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
